question: How many days of sick leave do I get each year, and when do I need a medical certificate?
reference: You get 10 working days of sick leave a year. A medical certificate from a registered medical practitioner is required for sick leave of more than 2 consecutive working days.

question: How much unused earned leave can I carry forward to next year?
reference: Up to 30 days of unused earned leave carry forward to the next year; any balance above 30 days lapses.

question: Can I carry forward unused casual leave?
reference: No. Casual leave does not carry forward; any unused balance lapses on 31 December, and it is not paid out on separation.

question: How long is maternity leave for my first child?
reference: 26 weeks of paid maternity leave for each of the first two children, of which up to 8 weeks may be taken before the expected date of delivery. To be eligible you must have worked at least 80 days in the 12 months before the expected date of delivery.

question: How many days of paternity leave do I get, and by when must I take it?
reference: 10 working days of paid paternity leave for each birth or adoption, up to two children, taken within 6 months of the birth or adoption in up to two blocks.

question: What happens to comp-off if I don't use it?
reference: Comp-off must be used within 60 days of being earned, after which it lapses. It cannot be encashed.

question: What is the notice period for a confirmed employee at level L3?
reference: 60 days, from either side.

question: How long is probation, and can it be extended?
reference: Probation is 6 months from the date of joining. It can be extended once, by up to 3 months, and you are told in writing before the original period ends.

question: When is salary paid each month?
reference: Salary is paid on the last working day of each month, or the previous working day if that day is a bank holiday. Payslips are on PeopleDesk by the 3rd of the following month.

question: What is the sum insured under the group health insurance and who does it cover?
reference: A family floater of Rs. 5,00,000 per year covering you, your spouse or registered partner and up to two children under 25, paid by the Company. Parents or parents-in-law (not both) can be added under a separate Rs. 3,00,000 parental cover, with the premium deducted from your salary.

question: How much is the referral bonus for an engineering hire, and when is it paid?
reference: Rs. 50,000 for engineering and data roles. It is paid after the new employee completes 90 days with Lumora, provided you are still employed.

question: What are the hotel limit and per diem for a business trip to Mumbai?
reference: Mumbai is a Tier 1 city: hotel stays are reimbursed up to Rs. 6,000 per night including taxes, and the per diem is Rs. 1,200 per day, with no receipts needed for the per diem.

question: Within how many days must I submit my expense claims?
reference: Within 30 days of the expense or the end of the trip. Later claims need department-head approval, and claims older than 90 days are not reimbursed.

question: Can I accept a gift from a vendor?
reference: Only if it is worth Rs. 2,000 or less and is not cash or a cash equivalent such as a gift card. Gifts above Rs. 2,000 must be declared to Compliance within 7 days, and you must never accept a gift of any value from a vendor during an active procurement or tender process.

question: Do I need approval to do freelance work on weekends?
reference: Yes. Outside employment or freelancing requires prior written approval from your manager and HRBP, and is never allowed for a competitor, client or vendor of Lumora.

question: How do I make a sexual harassment complaint, and is there a time limit?
reference: Make a written complaint to the Internal Committee at ic@lumora.example within 3 months of the incident, or of the last incident in a series. The IC may extend this by a further 3 months, and any IC member or your HRBP can help you.

question: How many days a week do I have to work from the office?
reference: At least 2 days a week, with Tuesdays and Thursdays as anchor days. Employees on probation are expected in the office at least 3 days a week.

question: Can I work from another country for a few weeks?
reference: Not without written approval from the People Team and Finance, because of tax and data-protection obligations.

question: How soon do I have to report a lost laptop?
reference: Report a lost or stolen laptop or phone with Company data to the IT helpdesk within 24 hours so it can be wiped remotely.

question: When will I get my full and final settlement after I leave?
reference: Within 45 days of your last working day. The relieving and experience letters are issued on the day the F&F settlement is processed.
gold_sections: 13.3 Exit Process and Full and Final Settlement

question: How many casual leave days do I get, and what is the per diem for international travel?
reference: You get 8 working days of casual leave a year. The per diem for international travel is USD 60 per day.
sub_questions: How many casual leave days do employees get per year?
What is the per diem for international travel?

question: What is my yearly learning budget, and how long does a performance improvement plan last?
reference: The learning budget is Rs. 40,000 per financial year with manager approval. A Performance Improvement Plan lasts 60 days, with fortnightly reviews.
sub_questions: What is the yearly learning and development budget?
How long does a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) last?

question: Can I use earned leave to shorten my notice period, and is unused sick leave paid out when I resign?
reference: Earned leave cannot be used to shorten the notice period, except that up to 5 days may be adjusted with your manager's approval. Unused sick leave is not paid out on separation.
sub_questions: Can earned leave be used to shorten the notice period?
Is unused sick leave paid out on separation?

question: Give me an overview of the leave policy.
reference: Full-time employees get 18 working days of earned leave a year (up to 30 days carry forward), 8 days of casual leave (no carry forward, at most 3 consecutive days) and 10 days of sick leave (carry forward up to 20 days; a medical certificate is needed for more than 2 consecutive days). There are 10 fixed public holidays plus 2 optional holidays. Maternity leave is 26 weeks for each of the first two children, paternity leave is 10 working days per child, and there are also adoption, bereavement (5 days for immediate family) and marriage (3 days) leave, compensatory off, leave without pay and an unpaid sabbatical after 5 years.

question: Does the company offer a car lease scheme?
reference: The handbook does not mention a car lease scheme. You could ask the HR helpdesk at hr-help@lumora.example.

question: Am I allowed to bring my dog to the office?
reference: The handbook does not cover bringing pets to the office. You could ask the HR helpdesk at hr-help@lumora.example.
